name: Prism
source:
Waking up in a cell with no memory, Cypress needs to find out what’s happening — and more importantly, a way out. The only person around is Walter, a scientist who may be more than he seems. 

Prism is a visual novel about the mind, change, and being locked up.

[From [url=https://gazpins.itch.io/prism]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
赛普拉斯在一个没有记忆的牢房中醒来，需要找出发生了什么——更重要的是，找到一条出路。周围唯一的人是沃尔特，他是一位科学家，但他的成就可能比他看上去的要多。

《棱镜》是一部关于思想、变化和被监禁的视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://gazpins.itch.io/prism]Itch.io[/url]]
